title: Dynamics of Many-Emitter Ensembles: Probing Cooperative Evolution with Scalable Quantum Circuits
summary: Many-particle quantum systems often give rise to exotic behaviors in their nonequilibrium dynamics that are rather challenging to reveal with analytical methods or with classical computation. Here, we consider the case of a system of many quantum emitters coupled through a radiation bath.
